responsibility: Implements the extended-basic-block scheduling front end for the Haifa scheduler. It groups fallthrough-connected blocks into EBB scheduling regions, computes and caches dependencies for those regions, initializes ready lists and schedule boundaries, handles CFG corner cases such as moving terminating control-flow insns and recovery blocks, and invokes the generic schedule_block engine from haifa-sched.c on each EBB. It is the EBB-oriented region driver, distinct from sched-rgn.c’s broader region scheduler.
